<!-- DswE3iSubmitBtn.vue -->
<template>
  <v-btn
    type="submit"
    :height="height"
    :width="width"
    :color="color"
    :disabled="disabled"
    :loading="loading"
    :text-dark="textDark"
    :flat="flat"
    @submit="$emit('submit')"
  >
    <slot />
  </v-btn>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  components: {
    //
  },
  props: {
    height: { type: Number, default: 28 },
    width: { type: Number, default: 111 },
    color: { type: String, default: "primary" },
    disabled: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    flat: { type: Boolean, default: false },
    loading: { type: Boolean, default: false },
  },
};
</script>
